# workflows.WorkflowRun

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

A run of a workflow in an organization, with its status and what it waits for.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `workflows.WorkflowRun` |
| Kind | `view` |
| PII | `personal` |
| Tenancy scope | `organization` |
| Permission | `core.workflow-run.read` |

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |

| `workflowId` | yes | `none` | Workflow of the run. |  |
